Stem yellow, moderately stout, slightly uneven or gently curved, not ruler-straight; it may show small brownish or yellowish glandular dots, especially above the ring, and some rusty-brown staining below the ring is allowed. No volva. Cap colour must read as yellow-gold even at a glance, never as the dark brown cap of S. luteus.

images.final_prompt:
Close-up scientific botanical illustration of the key diagnostic features of Suillus grevillei (larch bolete, maślak żółty) on a clean warm off-white paper background (#f6f5f1). Scientific Scandinavian botanical field guide illustration style. Crisp, clean scientific lines, watercolor and ink detailing, elegant, informative, no text labels.

A tight three-quarter close-up filling the frame, showing together: (1) the bright golden-yellow to orange-gold SLIMY, shining cap margin (not dark brown), (2) the yellowish to pale-cream, slightly slimy hanging ring on the stem, and (3) the yellow stem just ABOVE the ring, with small brownish or yellowish glandular dots/granules clearly visible. Yellow pores may be seen under the cap edge. This combination — yellow slimy cap + yellowish ring + dots above the ring — distinguishes it from Suillus luteus (brown slimy cap and purplish-white ring) and from Suillus granulatus (dots but no ring).

Use the attached photographs ONLY for real colours of the yellow cap, pores and ring; do not copy photo backgrounds or photographic texture. Render in ink and watercolor. Dots must be clearly visible at display size.

strictly NO dark chestnut-brown cap, strictly NO purple or violet ring, strictly NO missing ring, strictly NO gills, strictly NO volva, strictly NO scabers, strictly NO text or labels.
images.notes: Przyjęte v1: świetny złotożółty śluzowaty kapelusz, żółte pory, błoniasty zwisający żółtawy pierścień (wyraźnie inny niż białofioletowy u S. luteus). Ziarnistości pod pierścieniem były już na generacji; drobne brązowo-żółte grudki tuż NAD pierścieniem dorysowano PIL, żeby cecha była czytelna. Zastrzeżenie: grudki nad pierścieniem są trochę bardziej regularne i płaskie niż naturalnie błyszczące krople pod pierścieniem.
